description: This file contains action functions for handling hooks related to message posting, slash commands, message updates, and desktop notifications in the Mattermost web application.

methods.name: runMessageWillBePostedHooks
methods.description: Executes hooks before a message is posted, allowing modification or error handling.

methods.name: runSlashCommandWillBePostedHooks
methods.description: Executes hooks before a slash command is posted, allowing modification or cancellation.

methods.name: runMessageWillBeUpdatedHooks
methods.description: Executes hooks before a message update, allowing modification or error handling.

methods.name: runDesktopNotificationHooks
methods.description: Executes hooks for desktop notifications, allowing customization or error handling.
